WITH rpt_invoices AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.invoice_number, src.order_id, src.deal_id, src.deal_title, src.company_id, src.company_name, src.status, src.approval_status, src.subtotal, src.discount_amount, src.tax_amount, src.total, src.currency_code, src.due_at, src.paid_at, src.payment_method, src.created_by_user_id, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.created_at, src.updated_at, src.is_overdue FROM (
SELECT 
  inv.id,
  inv.organization_id,
  inv.number AS invoice_number,
  inv.order_id,
  inv.deal_id,
  d.title AS deal_title,
  inv.company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  inv.status,
  inv.approval_status,
  COALESCE(inv.total - COALESCE(inv.tax_amount, 0) + COALESCE(inv.discount_amount, 0), inv.total) AS subtotal,
  COALESCE(inv.discount_amount, 0) AS discount_amount,
  COALESCE(inv.tax_amount, 0) AS tax_amount,
  COALESCE(inv.total, 0) AS total,
  COALESCE(inv.currency, 'USD') AS currency_code,
  inv.due_at,
  inv.paid_at,
  inv.payment_method,
  inv.created_by_user_id,
  d.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  inv.created_at,
  inv.updated_at,
  (inv.status = 'overdue' OR (inv.status = 'sent' AND inv.due_at < NOW())) AS is_overdue
FROM crm.invoices inv
LEFT JOIN crm.deals d ON d.id = inv.deal_id AND d.organization_id = inv.organization_id
LEFT JOIN crm.companies c ON c.id = inv.company_id AND c.organization_id = inv.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = d.owner_user_id
WHERE inv.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT currency_code, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS overdue_invoice_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS overdue_amount FROM rpt_invoices AS invoices WHERE is_overdue = TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE GROUP BY currency_code LIMIT 500
